summary: Frontend storefront smoke and journey testing completed across desktop and mobile.
action_items: Add required-field validation and visible error states to all three checkout steps before allowing progression.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout advances with completely blank customer and delivery fields; this permits invalid orders despite presenting required customer/order details.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; frontend-local products and localStorage cart/wishlist were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified home, navigation, search results, full shop filter/sort/load-more, category route, product quantity/wishlist/cart, cart totals and removal, 3-step demo checkout with UPI/card selection, confirmation/cart clearing, account/order/info routes, mobile menu and no horizontal overflow. First load-more attempt after filtering was correctly skipped because only 3 filtered products existed.
rca of the issue: Checkout next buttons call next() without inspecting input values, so empty or malformed details still reach payment and order confirmation. Add controlled state or form validation per step, block progression, and render accessible error messages.
